scientific_limitations: Fixed unit-edge stars, two independent noise intensity classes, and nonnegative, linearly budgeted diagonal gains only.
Interior optimal hub gain is specified as a unique root of an explicit rational derivative, not by radicals.
A possible equivalent consequence of general weighted A-optimal-design literature remains unexcluded.
title: Golden-ratio noise threshold for reentrant feedback allocation on stars
